title: The Sauna's Breath
subtitle: A ritual of warmth in a frozen, hidden alley.
line: Enter a sanctuary where the biting winter cold melts into the embrace of wool and steam.
quote: To wear the knit is to wrap oneself in the quiet memory of a frozen forest.
synopsis: You step off the freezing street into an atmosphere heavy with the scent of pine and gentle steam. At the center of the narrow room, you find the steaming basin of ice, where liquid warmth rises in defiance of the frost. You circle this focal point, your fingers tracing the soft textures displayed on the surrounding plaster shelves, before finally reaching the wooden counter at the back to conclude your journey.

why.d: Shelf walls (knitwear display shelves) wrap the left, right and back of the 8 x 10 m room. The plaster shelves envelop you, providing a tactile experience of the winter-inspired knitwear collection.

why.d: The centre object (steaming basin of ice) is the first stop, 4.2 m in from the door. The steaming basin of ice acts as a sensory anchor, pulling you into the center of the space.

why.t: The circular flow encourages a meditative pace
why.d: The route circles it first, then follows the shelves. The circular flow encourages a meditative pace, mimicking the quiet rhythm of a sauna.

why.d: The counter (check-in counter) sits at the back, off the loop. The counter offers a grounding, intimate finale to your ritual of warmth.
